_comment: PNW mapd binary release pin. The ~20 MB pfeiferj `mapd` binary is intentionally NOT vendored in git (keeps clones and device updates small). system/mapd/installer.py downloads it at launch to the PERSISTENT /data/mapd/mapd (outside the git tree, survives auto-update git clean) and verifies `sha256` -- `install_path` below is NOT that live location, it's a legacy in-tree fallback only used off-device where /data isn't writable. To upgrade mapd: change version + url + sha256 + size here (get the sha with `sha256sum mapd`), nothing else -- BUT first check the device for a leftover /data/mapd/.override flag (`ssh comma@<ip> 'python3 -m openpilot.system.mapd.installer --check'`): while that flag exists, installer.py freezes the installed binary and silently ignores every pin bump (by design, for hand-deployed test builds -- see docs/GOMSGQ-SHADOW-FIX.md). Clear it with `rm /data/mapd/.override` on the device before expecting a version bump here to take effect.
name: mapd
